answer: Work waits on the quartz until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ferrous of the next round. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, reduced by each unverified claim, idle agents bleed standing. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the willow of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
